provider.name: World Echinoderm Database
provider.organization_type: global echinoderm taxonomy, nomenclature, fossil and extant classification, distribution, bibliography, specimen, image, trait, identifier, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: The World Echinoderm Database is a thematic taxonomic resource within the World Register of Marine Species and Aphia infrastructure. It covers living and fossil Echinodermata, including Asteroidea, Ophiuroidea, Echinoidea, Holothuroidea, Crinoidea, and related historical or revised classifications, with accepted names, synonyms, Aphia identifiers, classifications, distributions, literature, images, and cross-references.

purpose.authoritative_notice: The World Echinoderm Database, WoRMS/Aphia, original taxonomic publications, applicable nomenclatural codes, type repositories, official editors, release files, source databases, and cited authorities remain authoritative for names, acts, types, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
